Library visits per resident for Victorian public library services

Source: R/data.R
library_visits.Rd

Annual visits per resident for 50 Victorian public library services from 2022-23 to 2024-25, with one row per service and financial year.

Usage

library_visits

Format

A data frame with 150 rows and 4 columns:

library_service

Name of the library service.

financial_year

Financial year, from 2022-23 to 2024-25.

visits_per_person

Library visits divided by municipal population.

reported

Whether the library service submitted data for that year.

Source

Public Libraries Victoria, 2024-25 Annual Statistical Survey, Final Datasets 2022-23 to 2024-25. https://www.plv.org.au/resources/earlier-reports-and-surveys/ Data © Public Libraries Victoria.

Details

Visits per resident are calculated as branch and mobile library visits divided by the municipal population, following PLV definitions.

Indigo did not report in 2022-23, and Towong did not report in 2022-23 or 2023-24. These observations have reported = FALSE and visits_per_person = NA rather than using PLV estimates.

Library service names use the 2024-25 names in all years: Connected Libraries (formerly Connected Libraries (Casey)), Your Library (formerly Your Library (Eastern)) and Hyphen (formerly Wodonga). Vision Australia is excluded because no municipal population is available.

Only the calculated rates are stored, not the original visit counts or population figures. See data-raw/library_visits.R for the preparation steps.

See also

vic_visits

Examples

head(library_visits)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 4
#>   library_service financial_year visits_per_person reported
#>   <chr>           <chr>                      <dbl> <lgl>   
#> 1 Bayside         2022-23                     3.59 TRUE    
#> 2 Bayside         2023-24                     3.99 TRUE    
#> 3 Bayside         2024-25                     4.27 TRUE    
#> 4 Boroondara      2022-23                     4.68 TRUE    
#> 5 Boroondara      2023-24                     5.28 TRUE    
#> 6 Boroondara      2024-25                     5.46 TRUE
